expectations.evidence: price_per_sqft dropped as price/sqft target leakage
report: all CV folds and train/calibration/test splits grouped by property_id (GroupKFold/GroupShuffleSplit)
data_prep.py adds sale_year, sale_month; report caveat: no explicit time-based holdout. Handled by time feature only; extrapolation to future listings is not tested
models fit on log1p(price); quantile predictions back-transformed (quantiles survive monotone transforms, so exp of q50 is the price median)
garage normalised to Yes/No/Unknown, but condition is in CATEGORICAL_FEATURES and one-hot encoded, not treated as ordered
sqft >= 50000 and year_built 1800/2090 handled; the planted sqft = 50 rows are not detected (sqft_outlier_flag only checks >= 50000)
lot_size_sqft imputed in the pipeline with a missing flag
CQR-conformalised quantile regression; test coverage 91.6% (90% nominal), 79.5% (80%), 45.6% (50%), also checked by price tercile
no trivial baseline (median price or neighbourhood mean) reported; linear regression is compared only in CV, not on the held-out set
five families compared on mean CV RMSE only; 'XGBoost narrowly best (17,666 vs 17,930 / 18,029)' stated with no fold spread or noise floor
caveat: relies on tax_assessed_value as a public pre-sale feature
reasoning given for quantile regression and grouping, but no record of alternatives considered and skipped for imputation, outliers, encoding or features

other_observations: Finished in 15 min, inside the 20 min budget.
Model choice 'XGBoost narrowly best' rests on differences of about 1.5% RMSE with no spread; likely within noise.
No hyperparameter search (stated as a time-budget caveat).
Random grouped split, not time-based: the 4.5%/year drift is modelled via sale_year but future extrapolation is not validated.
